summary: OpenTelemetry interceptors fail to send traces because the SDK drops attributes with non-primitive or non-homogeneous array values, triggered by the PHP SDK's attribute handling.
userImpact: Users cannot use OpenTelemetry interceptors; traces fail to send due to attribute validation errors.
rootCause: OpenTelemetry SDK's AttributesBuilder rejects attributes containing non-primitive or non-homogeneous array values passed by the PHP SDK's interceptors.
proposedFix: Modified attribute construction in sdk-php-interceptors-opentelemetry to comply with OpenTelemetry's type validation requirements.
keyQuote: attribute with non-primitive or non-homogeneous array of primitives dropped
